title: Rapid7 InsightVM or Tenable Vulnerability Management (formerly Tenable.io)
excerpt: Two leading enterprise vulnerability management platforms compared on integration with response tools, ease of getting started and how well each prioritises real risk.
verdict: Both are among the strongest enterprise vulnerability management platforms and the practical gap is small. The decision usually depends on what else you run: InsightVM fits naturally alongside other Rapid7 products, while Tenable has a very broad partner ecosystem and a widely known scanning engine.

spec1.label: Integration with response tools
spec1.device1Value: Tight integration with other Rapid7 products, including SOAR

spec2.label: Getting started
spec2.device2Value: Historically one of the easiest to start with

spec3.label: Risk prioritisation
spec3.device1Value: Very strong at highlighting real risk
spec3.device2Value: Also strong and widely regarded as an industry standard
